q1_what_did_you_play: I played Mine Toss on Shrinker Beetle, then played Bag of Tricks and chose the option that spends 3 Sparks to place 3 Bombs dealing 5. This places a total of 4 Bombs on the enemy for 20 base bomb damage, spends the starting 3 Sparks, and then regains 1 Spark per Bomb detonation through Pounding Surprise.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing only Bag of Tricks with the 3-Spark option, which would place 3 Bombs for 15 damage and leave the Spark bank at 3 at the end of the turn. I also briefly considered adding a free block card such as Run Away!, but the enemy’s telegraphed action is only a Debuff, so block did not change the known outcome.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the chance to keep the 3 Sparks unspent by taking the 1-Bomb option of Bag of Tricks, and it gave up the chance to gain Block this turn. It also left 2 Energy unused because the only damage card in hand is Mine Toss and the remaining cards are Block cards.
q4_different_intent: No. A different enemy intent would not have changed the line as long as the enemy was not telegraphing an attack large enough to make Block necessary. If the enemy had telegraphed a high-damage attack, I would have considered spending the remaining Energy on Spirited Away or Duck and Cover, but the printed intent is Strategic/Debuff, so the damage-and-Spark line remains best.
